technology: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company 28-nanometer local reconstruction
boundary: Accepted native serial header and payload, all five group admissions, original key fills and the labels on existing retained-weight contracts.
proven_behavior: Valid actual group admissions capture key address and count from the correct current serial-command descriptor slice.
Each actual memory fill snapshots those original accepted serial key fields; fill-source base and count agree with that snapshot.
For an arbitrary valid resident key rank, the captured source address equals original serial fill base plus64 times rank, with the original fill count.
Later accepted commands and cached reuse preserve the old fill origin until another actual fill occurs. A later command must not relabel retained cached weights.
Original physical reset, canonical clock updates and optional local asynchronous-reset updates preserve the coupled serial, batch, group, source-address and persistent-fill histories.
The previously verified retained-weight contracts for all20 cores inherit this original serial-fill label. Their1280 physical row/strip cases were not rerun in this step.
persistent_fill_fault_types: cached origin wrongly changed to a later command
canonical_state_update_method: Shared physical registers use the original193-register source view in each group. Its actual group/address/key-field updates drive every overlapping invariant. Current fields and full admission/descriptor routing are rechecked against the original72-register group view, and the original source-address invariant is independently reconstructed exactly. No inconsistent parallel next value is assigned to a shared register.
scope: Component-local two-state provenance on the frozen mapped candidate. This joins accepted native serial words to original key fills and to the origin labels of previously qualified retained-memory contracts. It does not prove host packet/router delivery, command-tag return, external memory response data or ordering, the full mapped workload, model accuracy, timing, energy or paper matching. The final complete-native-feature review remains pending.
